about: The top web-facing domains of a Tranco list, in rank order, each with a task run_bank.py's checks judge: a search (url with {q}, three values) where the front page declares one, else a read of the front page (kind: read). probe.from: one GET of https://<domain>/ (then https://www.<domain>/) per domain, browser headers, redirects followed
